newsitem.title: USA: Successories Sept same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Successories Sept same-store sales up.

text.p: Successories Inc said Thursday that comparable-store sales for September rose 15 percent from a year ago.
It said year-to-date comparable-store sales gained seven percent.
The sales increases are primarily due to a new merchandising strategy, improved employee training at the store level and a data base marketing campaign geared to Successories retail customers.
Successories is a specialty retailer and catalog company that sells products for business and personal motivation.
